steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Finally, after a life-and-death battle, the seriously wounded monster disappears.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Super Lion thought she had restored peace forever.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But obviously the monster didn't actually get defeated, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's right. But what people didn't know is, that Super Lion's real identity was actually a little girl.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Whenever the monsters appeared and the city needed to be saved, the girl would take out her transformation device and turn into Super Lion.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Swish... OwO!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...What's that?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: The sound of the girl transforming into Super Lion. Isn't it cool?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Very cool.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmph...
After watching OwO perform the transformation sound, you continue telling her about your script.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Not long after the big battle, Super Lion found a small animal on her way home from school. The critter was badly injured and appeared to be dying.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: The poor thing... Super Lion will definitely help it!

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Purr!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes. Super Lion is very kind, so she took good care of the little creature.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Soon, they became close friends.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hehe, Super Lion finally got her own little sidekick!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But what Super Lion didn't expect was that the little creature's real identity was "Starzilla"!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It fooled Super Lion, pretending to be an innocent creature during the day, but at night, when Super Lion fell asleep, it would turn into a monster and wreak havoc!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Wow! What a plot twist!
